mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND portal_owner_id = #{portalUserId} AND remark = CONCAT('portal-upload:', #{requestKey}) ORDER BY file_id LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT files.* FROM sys_file files JOIN crm_service_ticket ticket ON ticket.tenant_id = files.tenant_id AND CAST(ticket.ticket_id AS CHAR) = files.biz_id JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.tenant_id = ticket.tenant_id AND customer.customer_id = ticket.customer_id WHERE files.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND files.file_id = #{fileId} AND ticket.deleted = 0 AND customer.deleted = 0 AND files.deleted = 0 AND files.access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND files.biz_type = 'CRM_PORTAL_TICKET' AND files.portal_owner_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT * FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_by = #{username} AND deleted = 0 AND portal_owner_id IS NULL AND (biz_type IS NULL OR biz_type = '') AND (file_type IS NULL OR file_type NOT IN #{privateType}) AND (CAST(file_path AS BINARY) = CAST(#{reference} AS BINARY) OR CAST(url AS BINARY) = CAST(#{reference} AS BINARY)) ORDER BY file_id LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND portal_owner_id IS NULL AND (biz_type IS NULL OR biz_type = '') AND (CAST(file_path AS BINARY) = CAST(#{reference} AS BINARY) OR CAST(url AS BINARY) = CAST(#{reference} AS BINARY)) AND file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY file_id LIMIT 1

SELECT physical.tenant_id, SUM(physical.object_size) AS total_bytes FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, MAX(COALESCE(file_size, 0)) AS object_size FROM sys_file WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id IN #{tenantId} GROUP BY tenant_id, storage_type, config_id, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(file_path, ''), CAST(file_id AS CHAR)) AS BINARY) ) physical GROUP BY physical.tenant_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{file.tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND storage_type = #{file.storageType} AND CAST(file_path AS BINARY) = CAST(#{file.filePath} AS BINARY)
AND config_id = #{file.configId} AND config_id IS NULL
FOR UPDATE
